verdict.rationale: Synthesia is an AI video creation platform, so in-video element replacement or restyling is a fair axis for it. The evidence never documents replacing or restyling an object or region inside an existing video while preserving the rest of the frame. The outfit/background changes apply to avatars in Synthesia-generated videos, and dubbing with lip-sync belongs to the translation story, so neither counts as support here.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact
